Somehow one of my best, most stable, well-behaved LoRAs yet. Great at humanoid witches, but sometimes needs some oomph for demons/animals. Likes giving characters eyelashes. Trained on "[color] sleeves, [color] leggings" with the default coven track colors being dark pink (Abomination), red (Bard), orange (Beast Keeping), yellow (Potions), Green (Plant), Light Blue (Illusionist), Blue (Healing), Purple (Oracle), and brown (Construction). Works a treat for dual-tracks, but isn't meant for more than two tracks.

Like what you see? Be sure to tip some buzz! Both blue and yellow are appreciated!

Also be sure to post what you gen with this LoRA, my LoRAs get lonely without your posts!

Also, did you know I take LoRA requests? There's a lot of things I won't make LoRAs of, but if you've got an idea, be sure to let me know!

title: Kaiju Drone Jaeger Hunters (Pacific Rim) (Illustrious) (AD) [LORA/Illustrious]
description:
This is an Illustrious lora for the Kaiju Drone Jaeger Hunters in the style of the Pacific Rim movie series. Inspired by Obsidian Fury from Pacific Rim 2 which initially went after the main character, I imagine a type of mech controlled by either a Kaiju mind, much like the Kaiju Drones or the Precursor aliens sending them. The purpose of the mechs would be to primarily hunt Jaegers and act as bodyguards for the Kaiju.

A weight of 0.8 to 1.5 works well with this with most models. Sampling Steps of 15 to 35 works well with most models, as does a CFG Scale of 2.5 to 5.

Prompts for this lora are ( KaiDroJaeHun, muscular, robot, mechs, ).

description:
Hiya, this is my first attempt at a LoRA with musubi-tuner. Krea2 seems a little light on pose LoRAs and this interaction has been very inconsistent when I try to prompt for it.

Seems to blend 'okay' with other LoRAs, but might have to lower the strength a bit.

27 image training set, auto captioned by Qwen Omni 30B. Selected epoch 16 after a few tests.

Trigger: full nelson wrestling hold

Strength = 0.5 - 1.5, lower values the hold is more relaxed or loose, 1.5 seems more aggressive

Sampler = Euler / Simple, might work with others but that's what I normally test with

Base prompt starting point, expand on it from there:

full nelson wrestling hold, <camera position>, <general setting>

The attacker is <character description>.

The defender is <character description>.

<additional details about character interaction>

title: Golden Hour - Krea 2 [LORA/Krea 2]
description:
Golden Hour Film Style for Krea 2: warm, nostalgic, faded film light ✨

Welcome to Golden Hour Film Style! This LoRA gives your Krea 2 images the feeling of a warm, nostalgic film photograph shot in the last light of the day: honey and peach tones, soft glowing highlights, gently lifted blacks and a dreamy, shallow depth of field. Clean and cinematic, with no added grain.

It's a style LoRA, not a character LoRA, so it works with any subject: people, places, food, animals, interiors and landscapes. Your subject stays yours, and the look comes from the LoRA.

What it gives you

  • warm golden-hour light and soft backlight with a gentle glow

  • a faded film look with lifted blacks

  • honey, peach, apricot, rose, sage and teal-shadow colour moods

title: FLUX 3 Image Klein Edit [Workflows/Flux.3 Klein]
description:
Say what to change, and FLUX 3 Image Klein edits your picture. A slider shows the picture before and after.

How to use it

  1. Load your image.

  2. Say the change, then what stays the same: "Change her black jacket to a red leather jacket. Keep her face, her hair, her pose and the street exactly the same."

  3. Run.

What you need

  • ComfyUI 0.41.0 or newer. That is the first version with FLUX 3.

  • AusBoss nodes 2.13.0 or newer. In ComfyUI-Manager, search "AusBoss". Already have them? Update first.

  • The FLUX 3 Image Klein files. They are on Hugging Face behind a license click: open black-forest-labs/flux-3-image-klein-comfy, sign in and accept, then these links work.

title: Motion-Speed-MMH3-SLIDER [LORA/MiniMax H3]
description:
Action Speed Slider [MiniMax-H3]

[English Version]

Function:

Adjusts character limb action speed and striking frequency (from rapid punch flurries to natural slow motion) while keeping the face, clothing, and background stable.

Parameters:

- Recommended Weight: ±4.0 (Tuning: ±1.0 ~ ±2.0, Max Limit: ±8.0)

- Trigger Word: None (plug and play)

- Base Model: MiniMax-H3

Effect:

- Positive (+): Speeds up limb action frequency (punches, sword swings, kicks, instrument playing, fast chopping).

- Negative (-): Decelerates into natural slow motion (Tai Chi, sword unsheathing, poised pauses, slow-mo closeups).

Action Speed vs. Motion Speed:

- Action Speed: Focuses on limb cadence and strike density (moving arms/legs fast in place).

- Motion Speed: Focuses on large spatial displacement (sprinting, dashing across the environment).

One year after my first experiments generating 360-degree images with Flux, I'm now taking a fresh approach using the klein 9b model. The results have improved significantly compared to my earlier attempts.

To achieve truly seamless 360° images, I trained a second LoRA specifically designed to support seamless inpainting. This additional LoRA helps repair the seams that typically appear where the image wraps around, ensuring a smooth transition across the entire panorama.

With this comfryui workflow—Flux Klein 360 Lora plus the seamfix LoRA—it's now possible to generate mostly seamless 360-degree images consistently.
